Then the decision record is declared on rwb.decision-record.v1 with the decision code DOCATT, final call STORED and the item kind as inputsRef content
    Then the record carries one entry per stored document and one per item the store refuses, the final call carries the item result and the message ID of a refusal, and a DUPLICATE item resolves to the entry of the item received first
